title: Production Auth Enforcement: Gate X-Actor Fallback Outside Local Dev
goal: Make the current X-Actor admin fallback explicitly local-development-only so production-style startup requires bearer API key authentication and cannot silently grant admin access without credentials.
scope: Authentication settings, auth dependency behavior, backend security tests, deployment documentation, and identity readiness reporting.
generation_reason: Code review found api/app/auth/__init__.py returns role=admin through X-Actor fallback whenever no bearer token is supplied. This is acceptable for local build-lane use only, but should be environment-gated before production-style use.

review_findings: CURRENT_STATE.md and security docs describe production-hardening boundaries

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Limit the slice to authentication fallback gating and tests. Do not build full SSO, SCIM, session management, or tenant membership enforcement here.
constraints.local_dev_preserved: Local development and existing tests may keep X-Actor fallback when APP_ENV/AEGISPT_ENV is development, test, or local and the explicit local fallback setting allows it.

success_criteria: Production-style environments reject unauthenticated requests instead of falling back to X-Actor admin.
Development/test/local environments preserve the existing explicit X-Actor fallback behavior with warning headers.
A configuration flag or derived setting makes the fallback boundary visible in identity readiness output.
API key bearer authentication remains compatible with existing role enforcement tests.
Tests prove fallback allowed locally, blocked in production-style startup, and documented as not enterprise SSO.

acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated production-style requests return 401 rather than admin fallback.
Local/test fallback still returns the explicit deprecation warning headers.
Bearer API key requests continue to enforce admin/operator/reviewer roles.
No live runtime behavior, runner dispatch, scope, credential materialization, or approval gate behavior is changed.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Adding SCIM, browser session enforcement, or tenant membership administration.
Changing assessment runtime, runner dispatch, approvals, scope/ROE, or kill-switch behavior.
